title: Prevent duplicate webhook delivery processing
description:
Repeated delivery ids are processed more than once.

Acceptance criteria:
- repeated delivery ids are processed exactly once
- deduplication records expire after the retention period
- existing webhook behavior stays backward compatible

title: Crash on cold start in the iOS app
description:
The app crashes on first launch after install.

Acceptance criteria:
- cold start completes without crashing on a clean device
- a regression test covers the first-launch path

title: Migrate billing to the new provider
description:
We need to move billing across.

Acceptance criteria:
- all existing subscriptions continue to bill correctly
- a rollback path exists

title: Redesign onboarding
description:
Onboarding needs a rethink before anything is built.

Acceptance criteria:
- design review completed
- flows agreed

description: Some tidying that has been sitting around for a very long time indeed and has plenty of description text.
